title: Good questions.
subtitle: Another doubt? Write us and we'll reply.

items.question: How much does a website cost in Chile?
items.answer: It depends on scope. After a short call we send a concrete quote — no commitment.

items.question: How long does it take to build a website?
items.answer: Landing: 2–3 weeks. Institutional site: 4–6. Custom features: 6–10. Confirmed in the proposal.

items.question: Will the site show up on Google?
items.answer: Yes. We deliver technical structure, clear URLs, metadata and an SEO base ready to index and grow.

items.question: Can I update my website later?
items.answer: Yes. We include a custom panel for texts, images and common sections — no code required.

items.question: Do I need copy and images before we start?
items.answer: It helps, but it isn't mandatory. We can advance with structure and placeholders while you define content.

items.question: What do I need for an online store?
items.answer: Catalog, payments, logistics and shipping rules. We guide you on tech and scope.

items.question: Do you offer Google ranking?
items.answer: Yes: technical SEO on the site and, if needed, content and campaign support.

items.question: Do you work with clients outside Chile?
items.answer: Yes. We work remotely with clients in Chile and Spanish-speaking markets.
